name: @moxxy/factorix-plugin-sdk
description: Build plugins for Factorix: trackers, pages, settings, and calls back into Factorix, served from your own server

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/package-dist.mjs
scripts.release: yarn build && npm publish ./dist --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('Publish the built package instead: yarn workspace @moxxy/factorix-plugin-sdk release')"
